posting.description:
Why GSK?
Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.
GSK is a global biopharma company with a special purpose – to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together – so we can positively impact the health of billions of people and deliver stronger, more sustainable shareholder returns – as an organization where people can thrive. We prevent and treat disease with vaccines, specialty and general medicines. We focus on the science of the immune system and the use of new platform and data technologies, investing in four core therapeutic areas (infectious diseases, HIV, respiratory/ immunology and oncology).
Our success absolutely depends on our people. While getting ahead of disease together is about our ambition for patients and shareholders, it’s also about making GSK a place where people can thrive. We want GSK to be a place where people feel inspired, encouraged and challenged to be the best they can be. A place where they can be themselves – feeling welcome, valued, and included. Where they can keep growing and look after their wellbeing. So, if you share our ambition, join us at this exciting moment in our journey to get Ahead Together.
Department Description
DNA-encoded technology (ET) is used to identify novel therapeutic compounds. This innovative approach enables the discovery of new drug candidates by leveraging the power of DNA sequencing and data analysis. Students will work as part of the ET Data Science/Engineering team located in Cambridge, MA, gaining hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies and contributing to significant advancements in the field.
The GSK SMR ET department internship program offers students hands-on experience working on data engineering projects that contribute to global health, alongside opportunities to learn from other engineers. We offer competitive compensation and GSK internship provides credibility and a unique opportunity to gain real-world experience in a leading healthcare organization.
Watch this before you apply!
GSK Early Careers Top Tips:
Learn practical advice from GSK on how to prepare a standout application and succeed in your early careers journey: GSK Early Careers Top Tips
Job Description
We're seeking a Web App Developer Co-op for a full-time, 6-month position at our Cambridge, Massachusetts site, working alongside our engineering team to design, build, and deploy web applications using ReactJS and modern front-end tooling. The role offers hands-on experience across the full development lifecycle, from UI implementation to Docker-based deployment and CI/CD pipelines. Ideal for a student or recent graduate looking to gain real-world software development experience in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
Minimum Qualifications
Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computational Science, or related disciplines.
Hands-on experience building web applications using ReactJS, including component design, state management, and integration with REST/GraphQL APIs.
Experience with Linux and Python programming.
Experience writing SQL queries and working with GitHub.
While GSK embraces a flexible work environment, we do require candidates who are hired to be onsite 3 full days a week.
Must be able to work full-time (35-40 hours/week) throughout the
6-month co-op (January ~ June 2027).
Must have an active student status and/or within 12 months post-graduation from a BS or MS degree program. Post-doctoral candidates are not eligible.
Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with modern web app tooling and practices such as TypeScript, Redux/Context API, unit testing (Jest/RTL), and deployment via Docker images with CI/CD for front-end deployments.
Experience working in Cloud environment
Demonstrated ability to translate requirements into technical specifications
Good problem-solving skills
Basic knowledge of biology or chemistry
Eligibility Requirements
Must successfully pass a drug screen and background check prior to assignment target start date.
Once your application is submitted, you will be prompted to complete our immersive GSK Digital Assessment. A passing score is required to proceed in the application process. After completing the assessment, a recruiter will review your application and contact you with next steps.
Please note: We recommend using your personal email when submitting your application as school emails tend to block external senders. If you do not receive an automated email after submitting your application, be sure to check your spam folder.
Atrium is committed to partnering with our clients to create inclusive work environments; to that end, if you need to request an accommodation to complete this application, please reach out to GSK@atriumworks.com.
Benefits
While GSK embraces a flexible work environment, we do require certain positions to be onsite. Candidates who are hired for an
on-site role or hybrid role
, and reside outside of 50-miles from their assigned work location, are eligible for relocation stipend. This is a one-time payment to help offset housing & relocation expenses. Please refer to the position details for the requirements of each position.
GSK Interns and Co-ops are offered a competitive hourly pay rate and benefits. Please note, benefits eligibility determined the month following date of hire.
This job posting is for a temporary role as an employee of Atrium on assignment at GSK. The individual selected for this role will be offered the role as an employee of Atrium; compensation, medical benefits, fringe benefits and other terms and conditions of employment shall be presented by Atrium upon offer. The pay rate range provided is a reasonable estimate of the anticipated compensation range for this job at the time of posting. The actual pay rate will be based on several factors, including educational degree obtained.In addition, this role will be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirement.
Pay Rate Range: $22/hr to $43/hr

Performs office management engineer work when needed including but not limited to; prepares meeting agendas and meeting minutes, assists in processing and maintains tracking logs for RFIs, submittals, pay estimates, and other deliverables.

Observes on-site material testing and coordinates testing and monitoring services.
Performs mathematical calculations for material quantity payments.
Performs basic shop drawing review and ensures that procedures and materials comply with plans and specifications.
Read and interpret construction drawings and specifications and identify discrepancies or conflicts within the documents.
Reviews contractor’s daily construction reports for accuracy, thoroughness, and consistency. Regularly reviews contractor's as-built mark-ups, documents project progress using video and photos, and prepares reports on construction progress.
Consults with Resident Engineer on work progress and construction problems, proactively recommends solutions and assists in the resolution of issues, and acts as a liaison with the engineer of record.

Performs other duties as assigned.

posting.description:
Role Summary
URBN is seeking a Data Science Intern who will support the Data Science team. You will design, build, evaluate, and support deployment of machine learning models and systems. This includes working closely with other data scientists, ML engineers, and data engineers to perform different tasks.
About the Summer Internship Program:
Each summer, URBN Inc. welcomes candidates from across the country to immerse themselves within various teams across our portfolio of brands and gain hands-on learning experience in the area of business they choose to pursue. Our paid internship program also offers a summer full of internfocused events, including exposure to senior leadership through small-group settings, insight into company initiatives, off-site field trips, and, for those who qualify, the opportunity to interview for a full-time position. See for yourself what our past and present interns are up to @urbncareers!The URBN 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from 6/7 through 8/13 at our Home Office in Philadelphia, PA.
Summer Internship Program Application Process:
1) Apply to one (1) internship posting that best aligns with your interests and skills. If there is a project component included in the application (see role qualifications below), it is required and must be submitted at the time of application to be considered for the position.
2) Complete a Video Interview: Candidates selected to move forward will receive an email with a link to complete a video interview. Once the email is received, candidates will have two (2) days to complete this portion of the application.
3) Interviews with our internal teams will be scheduled on a rolling basis.
4) To ensure you receive the most up-to-date information regarding your application, please make sure URBN is added to your safe senders or contacts so our emails do not go to spam. If you are using a school email address, please also include a personal email address in your profile as an alternate point of contact.
Applications will close at 5:00 PM EST on October 30, 2026.
Role Responsibilities
ML Modeling
: Evaluate and build statistical and machine learning models with an emphasis on business impact and time-to-production. Approaches span from basic regressions to advanced neural networks.
Analysis
: Support opportunities to add value to the business through application of statistical and ML techniques. Quantify the impact of those opportunities and communicate the outcome to peers and leaders.
ML Deployment
: Support ML engineers in deploying data science algorithms in production. This includes containerizing algorithm training and inference workflows, building data pipelines, and monitoring already-deployed ML systems.
Role Qualifications
Machine Learning Techniques
:
Understanding of machine learning algorithms, statistical analysis, and predictive modeling applied to real-world business use cases
Proficiency in one or more analytics methodologies such as time series analysis, clustering, and classification.
Machine Learning Tools
:
Proficiency in SQL.
Familiarity with relevant data science libraries and tools (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, ggplot2).
Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, etc.
Opportunities to Learn with the Team

Role Responsibilities
Set Preparations:
Prepare all samples before each shooting day: steam, hang, organize, lint roll, and remove all visible tags. Lay out all accessories, shoes, and/or additional styling needs prior to the start of each set.
Maintain on-set organization by keep the fitting room clean by removing previous items, rehanging, and retagging items. Assist the lead stylist in dressing the model for each look.
Refine technical pinning and styling skills by partnering with the lead stylists while on set.
Collaborate with File Management and teammates on set to accurately record cross-sell information for ‘Shop the Look’ data entry to the Free People Website.
Organization:
Maintain cleanliness of the studio at all times. Organizing of styling wardrobe area, maintaining on-set organization throughout the day and tidying the sets once shooting is complete, and ensuring the stylist area is always presentable and free of product, trash, or tags.
Partner with on-figure and flat styling, merchandising, and studio sample coordinating teams to maintain cleanliness of styling areas.
Research + Styling Projects:
Create trend presentations to share with the styling team to increase brand awareness, share upcoming trends, as well as showcase personal styling perspective.
Conduct research of intricate styling techniques, fashion trends, and outfitting. Partner with lead stylists to implement techniques while on set.

Our work environment relies heavily on teamwork, and we are seeking someone who is an excellent communicator and works well in groups.
The Styling Intern should have a genuine passion for on-figure styling, an interest in current and/or upcoming fashion trends, and a desire to expand the Free People brand through e-commerce imagery and styling opportunities.
The ideal candidate will also have a strong work ethic, creative innovation, innate organizational ability, a keen attention to detail, and a willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.
The following qualifications are appreciated, but not required.:
Prior styling or studio experience, particularly in the e-commerce, retail, or fashion industry
A strong desire to grow and learn within the studio space
Pursuing a degree in Fashion, Textiles, Design, Merchandising, or a related field

In addition to your application and resume, to be considered for this role please submit a Concept Board (8.5 X 11 PDF format is preferred). This is due at the time of your application submission.

featuring tears of images (styling, editorial, artistic, branding, etc.) that you find aspirational for the brand’s creative styling direction.

posting.description:
Become a part of our caring community
Are you ready to help shape the future of healthcare through data, analytics, and innovation? At Humana, we are committed to improving health outcomes and delivering more personalized, equitable, and effective experiences for the people and communities we serve.
As a Graduate Analytics Intern, you will work at the forefront of healthcare analytics and innovation while gaining exposure to Humana’s data-driven approach to improving quality, affordability, access, and member outcomes. Interns may contribute across several key teams, including Network Adequacy and Analytics, Reliance, Quality and Cost Strategy Analytics, Medicare Supplement, Humana Military, RASA - Research and Data Science, Care Management, Policy Governance. This experience is designed to help graduate students build practical analytics capabilities while contributing to Humana’s broader commitment to improving healthcare quality and member well-being.
This is a 12-week internship primarily based at Humana’s headquarters in Louisville, KY, with limited opportunities available in Arlington, VA; Chicago, IL; Ft. Lauderdale, FL; Nashville, TN; and New York, NY. The program is not offered remotely. Interns are expected to work in office 3-4 days per week based on leader & team needs.
Responsibilities
Develop analytical frameworks and solutions that address healthcare business challenges and support measurable outcomes.
Perform exploratory data analysis, statistical modeling, and insight generation in areas related to consumer health, healthcare quality, clinical outcomes, and well-being.
Combine and analyze diverse data sources to identify actionable insights about members, care experiences, healthcare utilization, quality outcomes, and health-related behaviors.
Develop predictive and prescriptive models that support acquisition, retention, engagement, quality improvement, loyalty, wellness, satisfaction, and sustainable health-related behavior change.
Apply machine learning, natural language processing, and large language model techniques, where appropriate, to support responsible healthcare analytics use cases.
Support development of tools and methods to identify, assess, and reduce stigmatizing or biased language in healthcare documentation using responsible AI and NLP approaches.
Create clear, compelling data visualizations and dashboards to communicate findings, trends, risks, and opportunities to business partners and leadership.
Translate complex analytical results into practical recommendations that support strategic decisions and operational improvements.
Work closely with business partners, clinicians, subject matter experts, analytics leaders, and cross-functional teams to deliver impactful, data-driven solutions.
Document methods, assumptions, limitations, and results in a clear and reproducible manner.
Demonstrate curiosity, collaboration, accountability, and a commitment to ethical, inclusive, and responsible use of data.
Use your skills to make an impact
Required Qualifications
Currently pursuing a master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data Science, Biomedical Informatics, Epidemiology, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Biostatistics, Engineering, Actuarial Science, or a related field.
Must be a current full-time graduate student with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and Summer 2028.
Must be available to work full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, on-site for the full 12-week internship from May 24, 2027, through August 13, 2027.
Must be willing to work in office 3-4 days per week based on leader & team needs at Humana’s headquarters in Louisville, KY, or one of our hub locations in Arlington, VA; Chicago, IL; Ft. Lauderdale, FL; Nashville, TN; and New York, NY.
Must not require sponsorship to work in the United States now or in the future.
Preferred Qualifications
Demonstrated programming skills in one or more analytical languages or tools, such as Python, PySpark, SAS, SQL, R, or similar technologies.
Foundational understanding of statistical analysis, data management, and analytic problem-solving.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working with complex healthcare, clinical, quality, consumer, claims, operational, or longitudinal datasets.
Ability to work with data in cloud-based or big data environments.
Experience with advanced statistical methods, such as linear and non-linear regression, survival analysis, causal inference, time-series analysis, or longitudinal analysis.
Familiarity with machine learning techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning, ensemble methods, dimensionality reduction, graph analytics, deep learning, natural language processing, or large language models.
Experience with responsible AI practices, including model interpretability, bias assessment, validation, privacy awareness, and ethical use of data.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or AWS.
Big data experience using technologies such as Spark, Hive, HDFS, Databricks, or similar platforms.
Experience developing dashboards, reports, or visual storytelling using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Python visualization libraries, SAS Visual Analytics, or similar tools.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and deliverables.
Effective communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to diverse audiences.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams and build productive working relationships.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint.
Internship Program Overview
:
During Humana's 12-week internship program, interns can expect a structured and immersive experience designed to accelerate professional growth, leadership development, and meaningful contributions to Humana's business priorities.
Comprehensive onboarding and orientation
that introduces interns to Humana's culture, strategy, mission, and enterprise priorities while preparing them for success within their assigned business area.
Placement on a high-impact team
where interns apply analytical, strategic, and problem-solving skills to meaningful projects aligned with Humana's business goals, customer needs, and organizational priorities.
Hands-on experience solving real business challenges
through strategic initiatives that provide exposure to data-driven decision making, innovation, and measurable business impact.
Executive exposure and enterprise networking opportunities
through leadership presentations, networking events, and capstone experiences that strengthen business acumen and increase visibility across the organization.
Dedicated development and support resources
, which may include leaders, mentors, coaches, program managers, and peers who provide guidance, feedback, and career development throughout the internship experience.
Leadership, professional, and career readiness development opportunities
designed to build the skills needed to become future leaders while exploring long-term career pathways within Humana's talent pipeline
Humana does not provide visa sponsorship or support for OPT/CPT/J1 for this internship position.
Scheduled Weekly Hours
1
Pay Range
The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.
$37,440 - $96,800 per year

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers benefits for limited term, variable schedule and per diem associates which are designed to support whole-person well-being. Among these benefits, Humana provides paid time off, 401(k) retirement savings plan, employee assistance program, business travel and accident.
About Us
About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

Complete ad hoc analysis requests from operational executives to support decision making
Attend monthly accounting department meetings

Visit various Hy-Vee supply chain and manufacturing facilities that contribute to the overall retail grocery business line
Weekly intern meetings with various members of accounting department leadership group including the Controller and Chief Financial Officer

Attend all-Hy-Vee intern socials to network with interns across Hy-Vee’s entire network

Primary Duties and Responsibilities
Loss Prevention and Asset Protection
Assist with monitoring store premises, including entry and exit points, aisles, sales floors, backrooms, and other high-risk areas.
Learn how surveillance systems, cameras, physical observation, and store patrols are used to identify suspicious activity and prevent theft.
Support Loss Prevention team members with inventory audits, shortage reviews, and other efforts designed to identify discrepancies and reduce shrink.
Assist with documenting theft-related incidents, suspicious activity, policy violations, and other loss prevention concerns.
Observe and support theft prevention strategies during special events, promotions, or high-traffic periods.
Safety and Security
Assist with identifying and reporting safety hazards, unsafe conditions, or security concerns within the store environment.
Learn company safety policies, emergency response procedures, and protocols related to evacuations, medical incidents, and other safety-related events.
Support Loss Prevention and store leadership in promoting a safe shopping and working environment for customers and employees.
Assist with preparing or organizing training materials related to asset protection, safety procedures, and loss prevention awareness.
Investigation and Reporting
Support investigations related to internal theft, external theft, fraud, misconduct, or violations of company policy.
Assist with reviewing surveillance footage, incident documentation, and other information used to support investigations.
Help organize case materials, prepare summaries, and maintain accurate documentation under the direction of Loss Prevention leadership.
Learn proper reporting practices for theft, security incidents, safety concerns, and policy violations.
Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive information, investigations, or company records.
Customer and Employee Relations
Interact with customers and employees in a professional, respectful, and customer-focused manner.
Work collaboratively with store associates, store management, Loss Prevention personnel, and Enterprise Security team members.
Support a positive and secure shopping experience while learning how to remain observant for potential security risks.
Provide assistance with basic loss prevention awareness efforts and help reinforce asset protection best practices.
Policy and Compliance Support
Learn and support company policies related to loss prevention, safety, ethical standards, confidentiality, and professional conduct.
Assist with compliance reviews, store-level checks, and documentation related to loss prevention and security procedures.
Support follow-up efforts related to identified concerns, trends, or operational opportunities.
Learning Opportunities
The Loss Prevention Intern will gain exposure to:
Retail loss prevention and asset protection operations.
Theft prevention strategies and shrink reduction efforts.
Surveillance systems, CCTV review, and physical observation techniques.
Internal and external investigation processes.
Incident reporting and documentation standards.
Inventory audits and shortage identification.
Store safety procedures and emergency response protocols.
Collaboration with store leadership, associates, law enforcement, and security professionals.
Professional communication, confidentiality, and ethical decision-making.
Qualifications
Currently pursuing a degree in Criminal Justice, Business, Security Management, Retail Management, Homeland Security, or a related field.
Strong interest in loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, retail security, corporate security, or law enforcement.
Strong observational skills and attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information professionally.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
Ability to remain calm, professional, and objective in a retail environment.
Previous retail, security, customer service, or internship experience preferred but not required.
Work Environment
This role may include a combination of office work, store visits, surveillance review, documentation, meetings, audits, and project-based assignments. The intern may observe store patrols, investigations, safety reviews, and loss prevention operations under the direction of Loss Prevention leadership.
Shifts may include days, evenings, weekends, holidays, or special events depending on business needs.
Physical Requirements
Ability to stand or walk for extended periods of time.
Ability to observe store operations, conduct limited patrols, and assist with store visits.
Ability to use a computer, surveillance systems, and standard office equipment.
Ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
Ability to perform duties in a retail store environment with exposure to customers, employees, and various departments.
Working Conditions
This position frequently involves a fast work pace in a general office setting. There is frequent pressure to handle multiple tasks in a day and meet deadlines.

Has access to confidential information including knowledge of employee confessions, and investigation proceedings on company personnel.

Discover Your Future with Inmar Intelligence: Where Potential Meets Purpose
For more than 45 years,
Inmar Intelligence
has helped some of the world’s leading brands, retailers, and healthcare organizations solve complex challenges through data, technology, and innovation. Our work has a meaningful impact on everyday life — from helping consumers save money to making healthcare safer and more efficient and helping businesses operate smarter.
Behind that work are people who are curious, collaborative, and motivated to make things better. At Inmar, our
High Challenge, High Support
culture creates an environment where people are encouraged to stretch their thinking, take on meaningful challenges, and grow — with the support and partnership to succeed.
Where Potential Meets Purpose
comes to life through the opportunities our interns have to learn, contribute, and grow. You bring your curiosity, perspective, and what you’ve learned so far. We give you opportunities to put that potential to work on real business challenges, contribute to projects that matter, and learn alongside experienced professionals invested in your growth.
At Inmar, we believe in:
Raising the Bar
in everything we do
Seeking Truth Together
through collaboration and learning
Putting our
Customer First
Your internship is a chance to explore what you’re capable of, build skills through real experience, and begin shaping what comes next.
About This Opportunity
Inmar’s Summer Internship Program offers a dynamic experience designed to give students real-world exposure to a professional environment while contributing meaningfully to company initiatives. Interns split their time between a high-impact cross-functional team project and department-specific responsibilities assigned by their direct manager.
Our
Data, Analytics & AI Internship opportunities
give students hands-on experience using data, technology, and analytical thinking to solve real business problems. Depending on business needs, opportunities may be available across areas such as
Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning, AI, Data Platforms, and other data-focused functions
.
As an intern, you may analyze data to uncover trends and opportunities, develop reports or dashboards, improve how information is organized and accessed, build or optimize data pipelines, contribute to predictive or analytical models, or explore how AI and automation can improve products, processes, and decision-making.
The technical depth of assignments may vary. Some opportunities may focus on
business analysis, reporting, visualization, and insights
, while others may involve
programming, data engineering, statistical modeling, machine learning, or cloud-based data technologies
. Across these opportunities, you’ll learn how teams turn data into insights, insights into decisions, and technology into practical solutions.
Please note: These internship opportunities are expected to be based onsite at our Winston-Salem, NC location and will require in-person attendance during the summer. This posting is intended to build our candidate pipeline for anticipated Summer 2027 Data, Analytics & AI internship opportunities. Specific internship assignments, responsibilities, team placement, and technology stack will be based on business needs and determined as opportunities are finalized.
What You May Do
Depending on your internship assignment, you may:
Analyze
business, customer, operational, or product data
to identify trends, patterns, gaps, and opportunities.
Help develop
reports, dashboards, metrics, and visualizations
that make complex information easier to understand and use.
Translate analytical findings into
clear insights and recommendations
for technical and nontechnical audiences.
Gather, organize, clean, validate, and prepare data from multiple sources for analysis, reporting, or product use.
Support the development, testing, and optimization of
data pipelines and data processing workflows
.
Help improve
data quality, reliability, documentation, governance, and accessibility
.
Contribute to the design and development of scalable data and analytical solutions using cloud-based technologies.
Explore, develop, or support
predictive models, machine learning, and advanced analytical solutions
.
Assist with organizing and structuring information to improve how teams access, manage, and use knowledge and data.
Collaborate with Data, Analytics, Engineering, Product, Business Intelligence, Operations, and other teams to solve business problems.
Apply
AI and emerging technologies
to research, analysis, coding, information organization, experimentation, or process improvement while maintaining appropriate review and validation.
What You’ll Gain
Hands-on experience using
data and analytics to solve real business challenges
.
Exposure to the lifecycle of data — from collection and preparation through analysis, visualization, modeling, and business application.
Opportunities to strengthen skills in
data analysis, business intelligence, data visualization, data storytelling, data engineering, statistical analysis, machine learning, and AI
, depending on your assignment.
Experience turning data and information into insights that help teams make better decisions.
Exposure to modern data platforms, analytical tools, cloud technologies, and evolving AI capabilities.
Experience collaborating with both technical and business teams.
Mentorship and guidance from experienced data, analytics, and technology professionals.
A better understanding of potential career paths across
Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning, AI, and related fields
.
Your Qualifications
Currently pursuing a
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Data Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, Economics, Engineering, Business, or another quantitative or related field.
Strong
analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills
with curiosity about what data can reveal.
Comfort working with data and using information to identify patterns, answer questions, or support recommendations.
Strong attention to detail and a willingness to validate, question, and clearly document findings.
Comfort using productivity and analytical tools such as
Excel and/or Google Sheets
.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain findings to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and work independently when appropriate.
Curiosity about data, analytics, AI, and emerging technologies and how they can be applied to real business problems.
Eagerness to learn new tools and contribute in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Depending on the Assignment, Preferred Skills May Include
Coursework or project experience in
data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, data science, machine learning, statistics, databases, or big data
.
Experience with
SQL, Python, R, Java, or other programming or analytical languages
.
Familiarity with
Tableau or other data visualization and business intelligence tools
.
Experience creating dashboards, reports, visualizations, or analyses that communicate insights from data.
Familiarity with relational or NoSQL databases and data management concepts.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as
Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Microsoft Azure
.

BigQuery, BigTable, dbt, Apache Iceberg, Starburst, Trino, Spark, or similar tools
.

TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, or similar technologies
.

Experience using
AI-assisted tools
for analysis, research, coding, documentation, or problem-solving with thoughtful review and validation.
Academic, personal, or open-source projects that demonstrate curiosity and hands-on work with data, analytics, or AI.
Why Intern at Inmar Intelligence
Your summer at Inmar is about putting what you’ve learned into practice while continuing to discover where your interests and strengths can take you. You’ll contribute to
real-world projects
, work alongside experienced professionals, and see how data, technology, automation, and innovation are shaping the future of business.
Beyond your day-to-day work, you’ll build connections through
mentorship, cross-functional networking, and collaboration with fellow interns
, with learning and development opportunities designed to support your growth. You’ll gain experience you can carry forward while exploring potential career paths and building relationships across Inmar.
You’ll also be part of an environment where
different perspectives are valued, ideas are encouraged, and community impact matters
— giving you the opportunity to grow professionally while contributing to something bigger than your individual assignment.
Bring your potential. Find your purpose. Discover your future at Inmar.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets.
Recruitment Fraud Notice:
Recruitment fraud is an increasingly common scam where individuals pose as employers to offer fictitious job opportunities. Scammers sometimes impersonate Inmar recruiters on LinkedIn and other channels. We will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. Verify any role on our official Workday Careers site and learn how to spot scams in our

Interns will apply mathematical modeling, discrete event simulation, statistics, and software development skills to analyze and improve semiconductor manufacturing operations. Projects may include developing and enhancing factory simulation models, building data pipelines and analytics solutions, conducting experiments, and supporting capacity, production, and operational decision making. Successful candidates will demonstrate strong quantitative problem-solving skills, programming experience in Python and SQL, and an interest in modeling complex manufacturing systems.

About Invesco
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
What’s in it for you?
Our people are at the very core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our benefit and perk offerings including:
Company networking events with other interns
Peer Sponsor Program
Leadership Connection series
Virtual Lunch and Learns
Invesco Cares volunteer events
Complimentary coffee and snacks
401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution
Job Description
Digital Assets Summer Internship – Early Careers Overview
Ready to make your mark in the world of asset management? Spend an unforgettable summer at Invesco alongside a select group of high performing students. Our 9-week Summer Internship Program, kicking off in June 2027, offers you the opportunity to delve into the dynamic world of client services within a global investment firm. You’ll learn from seasoned professionals, gain hands-on experience, and build lasting connections.
As part of our Summer Internship Program cohort, you’ll participate in orientation, networking events, development workshops, and volunteer activities. You’ll work side by side with talented teams to learn about the business and contribute to meaningful initiatives.
Here’s the best part: crush your internship, and you could be eligible for a full-time offer to join our Early Career Program after graduation!
Digital Assets Team Overview
Our team leads Invesco's global digital assets strategy, including tokenized funds, digital asset investment products, blockchain-enabled market infrastructure, and emerging onchain opportunities. Acting as a center of excellence across the firm, we partner with investment, distribution, technology, legal, compliance, and operations teams to bring innovative solutions to market. This internship will be located in our New York office.
What you’ll do:
Presentation & Documentation Support:
Develop executive presentations, market insights, competitive analyses, and product materials that support strategic digital asset initiatives and senior leadership decision-making.
Idea Contribution:
Share insights and suggestions during team meetings to enhance product offerings and improve processes.
Competitor Benchmarking:
Conduct industry, market, and competitor research across tokenization, stablecoins, blockchain infrastructure, digital asset managers, and asset servicers to identify trends and strategic opportunities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across technology, investments, distribution, legal, compliance, risk, and operations to support product development and commercialization efforts.
Project Variety:
Support high-impact projects related to tokenized funds, blockchain-enabled infrastructure, digital asset product development, client education, and strategic partnerships.
What you get:
Career Launchpad
– Build real-world skills and set the foundation for a future at Invesco—and beyond
Your Own Mentor
– Get paired with a mentor to guide your experience and support your growth
Intern Community
– Join a crew of fellow interns to collaborate, share ideas, and get to know—both in and out of the office.
Pathway to Future Opportunities
– Nail your internship, and you could be eligible for a full-time offer to join our Early Career Program after graduation!
Real Work, Real Impact
– Tackle meaningful projects and gain insight into client services at a global investment firm
Minimum Qualifications
Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree program and be a Junior graduating by the summer of 2028
We welcome diverse academic backgrounds, with preference for:
Technology: Computer Science, Information Technology, Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT), AI/Data Science
Business: Finance, Economics
Minimum GPA of 3.2 on a 4.0 scale
Demonstrated interest in digital assets, blockchain technology, and financial markets through coursework, research, student organizations, certifications, internships, personal projects, publications, or other relevant experience. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
Proficiency in Excel (e.g., pivot tables, advanced functions) and PowerPoint
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
Strong organizational abilities, leadership qualities, and interpersonal skills
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, demonstrating initiative, adaptability, and ownership. Highly self-motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented
Must be able to work in Invesco's New York office
Preferred Qualifications
Digital assets or blockchain experience through internships, research projects, investment clubs, hackathons, coding projects, certifications, content creation, or other relevant activities strongly preferred.
Basic knowledge of mutual fund operations and capital markets
Familiarity with programming languages such as R, Python, or VBA is a plus
Experience with data visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau
Understanding of AI applications (e.g., chatbots, predictive analytics)
Compensation for this position is $40/hr.
Full Time / Part Time
Full time
Worker Type
Student/Intern (Fixed Term)
Job Exempt (Yes / No)
No
Workplace Model
Pursuant to Invesco’s Workplace Policy, employees are expected to comply with the firm’s most current workplace model, which as of October 1, 2025, includes spending at least four full days each week working in an Invesco office. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Invesco's culture of inclusivity and its commitment to diversity in the workplace are demonstrated through our people practices. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are searching for the best talent for
Systems & Simulation Engineering
Interns within Robotics R&D.
Purpose:
This internship is based in Santa Clara, California and offers a unique opportunity for students with a background in systems engineering, robotics, simulation, controls, software, or mechanical engineering who are passionate about medical robotics. Interns will work alongside systems, mechanical, mechatronics, controls, electrical, software, and clinical engineering teams to support the design and analysis of complex robotic systems. This role will contribute to architectural modeling, simulation-based design, requirements development, system characterization, and verification activities that help advance robotic surgical platforms and improve patient outcomes worldwide.
As a
Systems and Simulation Engineer Intern
, you will work on the development and testing of robotic surgical systems through systems engineering and simulation-based analysis. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to model complex system behavior, evaluate design tradeoffs, support requirements development and verification, and generate insights that inform system architecture and design decisions. This role offers exposure to advanced robotic technologies, model-based development practices, and simulation tools used throughout the product development lifecycle.
You will be responsible for:
Support the development and execution of system-level and subsystem-level simulations for robotic surgical platforms.
Collaborate with systems, mechanical, electrical, controls, and software engineers to model system behavior and evaluate design performance.
Analyze simulation and test data to identify trends, characterize system performance, and provide recommendations to guide engineering decisions.
Assist with requirements development, traceability, and verification planning to ensure system designs meet intended performance objectives.
Support system architecture studies, tradeoff analyses, and interface definition activities across multidisciplinary teams.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, engineering reports, and presentations summarizing simulation methodologies, assumptions, results, and conclusions.
Support laboratory testing and correlation of simulation results with experimental data.
Contribute to the creation of tools, scripts, or automation workflows that improve analysis, simulation, and engineering efficiency.
Role Variability
This internship track covers a range of Systems Engineering and Simulation-focused roles. Responsibilities will vary depending on the specific project, team, or business need and may include system architecture, requirements engineering, verification and validation, modeling and simulation, controls analysis, performance characterization, or robotics-focused system development activities.
Qualifications / Requirements:
Education
Applicants must be pursuing a graduate degree or a bachelor’s degree (junior or senior) in Systems Engineering, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, and must plan to return to an academic program after the completion of the internship.
Experience and Skills
Self-starter with a consistent record of engaging in self-directed learning and remaining productive with minimal direction.
Fundamental understanding of engineering principles including dynamics, controls, robotics, mechanics, or system modeling.
Experience using engineering analysis, simulation, or computational tools through coursework, research projects, design teams, or internships.
Experience collecting, analyzing, and interpreting technical data to draw meaningful conclusions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical work clearly.
Available to work full-time (40 hours/week) and during hours agreed upon with the hiring manager.
Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 reflective of all coursework.
Commitment to June 1 – August 20, 2027, or June 21 – September 10, 2027; term dates to align with cohort.
Must have work authorization in the United States at the time of hire and maintain ongoing work authorization during employment.
Nice-to-Have
Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, evaluate, and adopt new AI tools and platforms to meet evolving project needs.
Experience with simulation and modeling tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, ANSYS, Abaqus, Simscape, Gazebo, or similar platforms.
Familiarity with finite element analysis (FEA), multibody dynamics, controls simulation, or system performance modeling.
Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, C++, or similar languages.
Experience developing scripts to automate data analysis, simulation workflows, or testing activities.
Exposure to systems engineering concepts such as requirements development, requirements traceability, interface management, risk analysis, or verification and validation.
Experience partitioning and decomposing complex engineering problems into solvable problems.
Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, medical devices, or other complex electromechanical systems.
Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), SysML, JAMA, DOORS, or similar systems engineering tools.
Why Join Us?
Contribute to impactful projects that directly improve surgical outcomes and patient safety.
Gain broad exposure across robotics, AI/ML, system integration, and clinical workflows.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including electrical, mechanical, and controls engineers.
Work in an inclusive, innovative, and growth-oriented environment.
Mentorship and professional development opportunities.

ursue consistent alpha through rigorous scientific research and sustained investment in technology and data infrastructure. Our strategies are deployed across global markets, spanning multiple geographies, asset classes, and trading horizons.

Developing and refining quantitative trading strategies under the guidance of experienced portfolio managers and researchers

Chicago Trading Company (CTC) is a premier proprietary trading firm specializing in options market making. Our collaborative culture fuels innovation in quantitative research, systematic trading strategies, and cutting-edge trading technology. For over three decades CTC has provided critical liquidity across derivatives exchanges worldwide - making them fairer, more transparent, and more efficient.
We strive to be the most innovative firm in the industry today, tomorrow, and long into the future while upholding ethical excellence. We believe that CTC makes a positive impact on the markets, the lives of our employees, and all the communities to which we belong. Started in 1995 by a team of forward-thinking Traders, we are proud to call ourselves an industry leader that keeps making markets and each other better.
The Role
As a Quant Trading (QT) Intern, you will be challenged to learn and adapt in an exciting team environment and will play a substantial role in our day-to-day trading and quant-related activities. Your impact is immediate and meaningful. You will become a member of a team for the summer and play a vital role completing project work and/or identifying trading opportunities and communicating with software engineers, quants, traders, and risk managers throughout the trading day. As part of the Summer Associate cohort, you will learn and socialize alongside other QT Interns and Software Engineering (SE) Interns.
What to Expect
The 8-week internship program gives you insight into our culture and an inward look into what our business is all about. You will participate in three classroom learning experiences including: a week-long Basics of Options class, a multi-week class on the fundamentals of market making (Mock Trading), and a multi-week class that introduces elements of our quant framework (Quant Curriculum). You will also attend planned social activities and talks from various business leaders to propel your professional growth, and build your network with CTC employees and fellow interns. You will:
Work in an impactful role mirroring that of a full-time Quant Trading Associate (QTA)
Get hands-on experience with trading and exposure to our trading technology
Have weekly one-on-one meetings with your manager to ensure you are progressing and learning throughout the program
Receive mentorship from members of our trading and/or quant teams
Experience a culture with a strong emphasis on teamwork and collaboration built through various educational and social activities
What it takes for you to be successful
You have a competitive drive and are a highly motivated individual that only gets stronger as part of a collaborative team
You have a desire to work in tandem with traders, quants, developers, and other experts to further CTC’s goal of providing world class liquidity to financial markets
You love solving complex problems
You’re intellectually curious and like to challenge the status quo
You can effectively communicate sophisticated ideas both written and verbally
Strong quantitative and analytical abilities
Basic programming skills or a willingness to learn Python
No prior experience in finance is necessary, but a deep curiosity and hunger to learn about finance and trading is essential
Key Requirements
You are pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree. All majors and concentrations welcome.
You will graduate between December 2027-June 2028
You have a demonstrated record of success (academics, awards, etc.)
You are willing to relocate to Chicago, IL for the summer (with full-time placement in Chicago)
You can participate in the full duration of the 8-week program from mid-June to early August 2027
Why should you consider interning at CTC?
Be part of a fast-growing, industry-leading global trading company
Work in an environment that actively explores and applies emerging technologies — including AI — to enhance trading, engineering, and research workflows
Opportunity to work with and learn from leaders in our industry
Excellent support system to ensure your learning and development
Competitive pay, free housing with your fellow interns in downtown Chicago, and free breakfast, lunch, and snacks!
Compensation
Monthly salary of $16,500 plus a signing bonus
Please note:
You are allowed to submit one application per position (i.e. SE Intern and QT Intern) during the recruiting cycle. We recommend focusing on applying for the role that aligns most closely with your skills and interests. While you can apply for more than one role, please keep in mind that each application will be assessed according to the specific requirements set for that role.
Most teams at CTC, with the exception of Trading, follow a hybrid workplace model, subject to change based on business need.
Our Benefits
We strongly believe in the well-being of our employees and their families so we offer outstanding benefits to support you both professionally and personally. These benefits include generous medical coverage, paid parental leave, free breakfast and lunch (plus healthy snacks, of course), wellness reimbursement, quarterly recharge days, and a variety of other benefits focused on providing the best employee experience.
(Disclaimer: interns and contractors are not eligible for benefits at CTC)
Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
At CTC, we aim to cultivate a workplace that celebrates diversity and each person feels included, engaged and empowered. Where each of us feels we belong. We are committed to having a diverse workforce and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. CTC does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.
If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to apply for a position, please contact us at info@chicagotrading.com. Note that emails sent to this email account for non-disability related issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.
Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)
Information submitted by job applicants may be subject to review and analysis by automated systems, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), as part of the recruitment process. Such systems are utilized to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our hiring procedures. Applicants are advised that any information provided may be evaluated by AI tools to ensure an equitable and thorough assessment.

About Us
:
Founded more than 15 years ago and headquartered in Chicago, the DV Group of financial services firms has grown to more than 600 people operating throughout North America and in Europe. Since spinning out of a large brokerage firm in 2016, DV Trading has rapidly scaled as an independent proprietary trading firm utilizing its own capital, trading strategies, and risk management methodologies to provide liquidity to worldwide financial markets and hedging opportunities to commodity producers and users. Now, DV group affiliates include two broker dealers, a cryptocurrency market making firm, and a bourgeoning investment adviser.
DV Commodities is a division within DV Group that specializes in trading commodities markets, including crude oil, refined products, natural gas, power, emissions, metals, softs, and agriculture. DV Commodities' risk management, world-class technology, and talented traders have enabled it to become one of the world’s largest liquidity providers and risk allocators in the energy and commodities spaces. DV Commodities currently has over 35 desks, with traders and staff located in London, New York, Chicago, Houston, and Dubai.
Overview:
As a Software Development Intern, you'll work in small groups within our development team and/or trading teams to assist in building low latency applications, systems and trading tools that will make a direct impact to DV. You'll deliver well-scoped, self-contained projects within our established production codebase, learning to build new functionality that integrates cleanly with mature systems. You'll use AI tools to accelerate your development while taking full ownership of the code you ship. Through your work and other development opportunities, you will grow your technical skills and understand how our technology stack empowers our firm to serve our trading teams.

Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field and expected to graduate between

Proficient in one or more general purpose programming languages, including C++ and/or Python

Effective use of AI coding tools paired with the ability to critically review generated code and own its correctness
Strong quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills, ideally applied to numerical or performance-sensitive problems
Ability to work onsite at our New York office 5 days a week

SOFTWARE ENGINEERING INTERN (SUMMER 2027)
Freeform is deploying software-defined, autonomous metal 3D printing factories around the world, bringing the scalability of software to physical production. Our proprietary technology stack leverages advanced sensing, real-time controls, and data-driven learning to produce digitally verified, flawless parts at unprecedented speed and cost. Our mission is to make the transformative power of 3D printing available to all industries at scale and unlock the future of innovation.
As a Software Engineering Intern at Freeform, you’ll help build the core software systems that power our autonomous metal 3D printing factories. You’ll work with a talented engineering team from some of the world’s most innovative companies across a range of projects to develop and maintain mission-critical infrastructure - including controls, high speed data acquisition, and geometry processing pipelines - that enable high-speed, high-quality, and fully automated production. This is a hands-on role where you’ll contribute to real-world solutions that bridge software and hardware, and gain exposure to a fast-paced, multidisciplinary engineering environment. You’ll be encouraged to take a first-principles approach to problem solving, explore new technical domains, and collaborate across teams to help bring complex systems to life.
3D printing experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who love solving hard problems and creating amazing technology!
Responsibilities:
Support the design and development of software for advanced, production-scale metal 3D printing systems
Collaborate with process, control, and mechanical engineers to help integrate control algorithms into production software
Assist in improving and scaling high-rate data acquisition, storage, and retrieval systems
Contribute to the development of the software pipeline that converts customer part geometries into machine-ready print instructions
Basic Qualifications:
Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or electrical engineering from an ABET accredited university or college
Internship or engineering club experience such as FSAE, Baja SAE, solar car, rocket club, robotics club, or similar programming with
C/C++ or Rust
Nice to Have:
Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in computer science, computer engineering, or electrical engineering
Experience interfacing with microcontrollers, FPGA, or GPU computing hardware
Experience developing embedded or real-time software systems
Experience writing software for industrial automation systems, robotics, or related hardware
Experience working in a Linux environment
Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and iterating quickly (comfortable building the plane as we fly it)
Strong communicator who collaborates across disciplines and proactively seeks support when needed
Willing to take ownership of tasks big and small, with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset
Strong work ethic with a refuse-to-fail mindset
Demonstrated indicators of excellence and/or achieving success against adversity (i.e. top academic performance, leadership in engineering clubs, first-generation college student, or other examples of resilience and achievement)
Location:
We are located in Hawthorne, CA in a 35,000 square foot, state-of-the-art facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.
What We Offer:
We have an inclusive and diverse culture that values collaboration, learning, and making deliberate data-driven decisions
We offer a unique opportunity to be an early and integral member of a rapidly growing company that is scaling a world-changing technology
Compensation and Benefits
The compensation for this role:
Engineering Intern/Undergraduate: $34/hour
Engineering Intern/Masters: $36/hour
Engineering Intern/PhD: $38/hour
Relocation assistance
Free daily catered lunch and dinner, and fully stocked kitchenette
Casual dress, flexible work hours, and regular catered team building events

Thank you for your interest in our internship opportunity! We truly appreciate your application and enthusiasm to join our team. Please note that our interview process will begin after we attend university career fairs in early fall. The process will include 2-3 rounds of virtual interviews. We anticipate wrapping up the interview process by late Fall.

posting.description:
About the company
General Matter enriches uranium.
We are designing, building, and operating the world’s lowest-cost enrichment services, here in the US.
In the process, we are restoring America’s ability to produce nuclear fuel to power AI, advanced manufacturing and critical industries our country relies on to remain competitive.
Fuel drives the cost of advanced reactor electricity production, and enrichment drives the cost of the fuel that advanced reactors consume. Reliable, low-cost enrichment is the catalyst for the nuclear Renaissance now under way.
Our mission is to make nuclear not only the cleanest and safest source of baseload power, but also the most affordable. We believe abundant nuclear energy will lead to a post-scarcity society.
We were incubated inside Founders Fund, like Anduril and Palantir before us, and are backed by over a dozen of the world's top venture capital firms.
Our lean, world-class team of engineers and operators is applying a first-principles approach to solving the problem of nuclear fuel production.
We are a mission-driven company with a culture of urgency, accountability, and transparency.
Help us build a high-energy society by making the cleanest, safest form of baseload energy the most affordable.
About This Role
As a General Matter Software Engineering Intern, you will help develop performant, safe, and high-quality software. Your work will support code where reliability, performance, and safety are of utmost importance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including electrical engineers, software engineers, chemical engineers, manufacturing engineers, nuclear engineers, materials scientists, and physicists. If you seek high-impact work and are excited by fast-paced, intense, Skunkworks-style projects, we encourage you to reach out to join our team.
We're hiring interns across three focus areas:
Backend interns will help build high-performance services and APIs that coordinate control systems, manage state across distributed hardware, and expose interfaces for monitoring and operations.
Distributed systems interns will support the development of fault-tolerant coordination systems, real-time data pipelines processing high-throughput sensor telemetry, and the infrastructure that keeps critical systems running reliably at scale.
Tooling interns will help build the developer platforms, CI/CD systems, observability tools, and deployment infrastructure that let our team iterate rapidly and safely in a production environment where mistakes have physical consequences.
Responsibilities
Assist in designing and implementing high-performance software systems in C++ and Python, with a focus on reliability and maintainability.
Support the architecture of solutions, contributing to decisions around system design, performance trade-offs, and technology selection.
Participate in technical design reviews and code reviews, learning and helping uphold engineering best practices across the team.
Help build and maintain automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to support software quality at scale.
Work closely with senior engineers, contributing to progress on complex, ambiguous technical problems.
Basic Qualifications
Current undergraduate or graduate student pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
Proficiency in C++ and/or Python.
Strong CS fundamentals, such as algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and system design.
Collaborative team member who thrives in fast-paced, multidisciplinary environments and is eager to learn.
Preferred Skills and Experience
Exposure to distributed systems, observability tooling, or infrastructure as code.
Experience with Python ecosystems for data pipelines, automation, or backend services.
Coursework or project experience with C++ performance optimization, profiling, or low-level systems programming.
Familiarity with Linux system programming, including threading models, IPC, or low-level kernel interfaces.
Evidence of exceptional ability (prior projects, portfolio of work, completed products, etc).
Additional Requirements
Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary.
Equal Opportunity Employer
General Matter is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with General Matter is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
Compensation and Benefits
The hourly pay range for this internship is
$32–$46
per hour, depending on the candidate's current standing in school (i.e. sophomore, senior).
Interns will receive a monthly housing stipend and are eligible for overtime pay. Please note that the stated hourly range is an estimate and may be adjusted based on market conditions, business needs, or other factors.

K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.
The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.
With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.
The Role
We’re looking for a stellar Electrical Engineering Intern to join our team for a 3 month internship. Working closely with our engineers, you will be responsible for developing novel electrical designs spanning from PCBAs to full systems. You will work hands-on with novel power, digital, and mixed signal designs used across the satellite while getting exposure to other subsystems within the engineering organization. K2 Space is a highly collaborative environment and our interns will be encouraged to work with mentors and other team members to execute complex projects.
Responsibilities
Design electronics PCBAs for spacecraft including architecture, component selection, circuit board design, board bring up and debugging
Qualify your designs through environmental testing including vibration, shock, thermal, and thermal vacuum testing
Work with internal and external stakeholders to integrate your designs into the spacecraft systems and operate your hardware in flight
Develop test equipment, development PCBAs, and test scripts to assist with all of the above
Qualifications
Must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical or computer engineering
6+ months experience of technical engineering skills outside of the university setting classroom (eg: laboratory, research, extracurricular project teams, volunteering, personal projects or prior internship/work experience)
Nice to Have
Ability to work well in an integrated collaborative team environment, including frequent interactions with technicians, engineers, and managers
Experience designing multi-layer PCBAs for high-speed digital applications
Experience with high performance kW scale isolated power converter design
Experience designing analog control loops, solid state load switches, motor inverters, EMI/EMC compliance, or sensor signal conditioning circuits
Experience with digital processors, FPGAs, memory chips, or network switches
Proficient with circuit simulation tools such as LTspiceE
Experience with load switch design and power path protection schemes
Experience programming in C/C++, Python, or Matlab
Compensation
Hourly pay range for this non-exempt role is $30 - $40 per hour
Hourly rate will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
Housing and travel stipend may also be available
If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!
If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

posting.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.
The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.
With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.
The Role
We're looking for a stellar intern to join our team for a 3 month internship. Working closely with K2 engineers in a highly collaborative environment, you will be responsible for owning a software engineering project end-to-end and supporting actual on-orbit operations of our spacecraft. You will interact with advanced technologies like cyber-physical system simulators, satellite sensors and actuators, build systems, GNC algorithms, and more.
Responsibilities
Develop physics-based software models for testing control of spacecraft subsystems, including propulsion, guidance/attitude control, thermal, power, and communications systems
Author drivers for simulation hardware
Create and utilize robust tools to allow for rapid deployment of quality code
Perform data analysis and anomaly investigation to identify and resolve software bugs
Support integration and testing of spacecraft subsystems
Qualifications
Development experience in Rust, C++, or similar compiled language
Coursework or experience in numerical methods, ordinary differential equations, mechanics, and electricity and magnetism
Additional Requirements
Available for a minimum 12-week internship in person at our HQ in Torrance
Nice to Have
Experience using scientific Python (NumPy, SciPy, etc.), Julia, MATLAB, or similar
Experience defining and creating simulation systems for both hardware-in-the-loop and hardware-out-of-the-loop testing
Experience with Monte Carlo simulations and probability/statistics
Experience with linear algebra, signal processing, controls, and/or orbital mechanics
Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery systems
Experience with Linux systems programming and driver development
Basic knowledge of electronics, computer architecture, and control systems
Compensation
Hourly pay range for this non-exempt role is $30 - $40 per hour
Hourly rate will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level
Housing and travel stipend may also be available
If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!
If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.
Export Compliance
As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”
The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by
22 C.F.R. § 120.15
or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.
Equal Opportunity
K2 Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with K2 Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
