posting.description:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying.
At Klaviyo, our Engineering teams build scalable, high-performance systems that power both our product and the infrastructure behind it. As a Software Engineering Intern, you'll be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team whose work reaches thousands of customers worldwide. You won't just be writing code. You'll be solving hard problems, shaping how users experience our product, and learning from engineers who've been doing this for a while.
This internship is your shot to put your software development skills to work in production. You'll be embedded on one of our engineering teams (see overviews below), take on projects that matter to our customers, and build a technical foundation as you make connections across the business.
Our interns come from all kinds of coding backgrounds, but they all share one thing: they're excited to build, own, and scale features end-to-end, from scratch. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, take on hard technical problems, and ship code that supports Klaviyo's mission. We're an AI-first company, so you'll be expected to use AI tools to support your work, learn faster, and do your best work here.
How you'll make an impact
Own features that our 180K+ paying customers rely on daily to reach their consumers and grow their business.
Take responsibility for the mission, technical direction, and operation of projects with immediate impact.
Own the full lifecycle of your code: writing it, testing it, shipping it, and making it better over time. Ownership is expected here, not just encouraged.
Build and ship features that meet a high bar and grow your technical skills while you do it.
Get hands-on debugging real issues, both locally and in production.
Contribute to documentation and support your team during incidents (real-world problems teach you things a tutorial never will).
Work closely with your teammates: ask questions, share ideas, and get better by taking feedback seriously.
Learn to use the right tool for the job, lean into AI, and keep looking for ways to make things better.
Put AI at the center of how you work to move faster. Build smarter systems and better workflows from the ground up.
Who you are
At least one previous software engineering internship or co-op, with hands-on software development experience
Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math/Statistics, or a related field
Graduating in December 2027 or May/June 2028
Experience with some of these technologies and languages:
Python, Django, Typescript, React, Go
MySQL, Cassandra, Clickhouse, Kafka, Redis
Amazon Web Services (EC2, RDS, Aurora, etc.), Terraform
You enjoy working across new technologies and you’re excited to work across the stack from back-end to front-end work
You love digging into performance and scalability issues to find breakthrough solutions: a slow-loading UI, too many clicks in a workflow, a database query timing out, a queue that won't drain. You believe every problem can be solved, and you'd rather run toward it than around it.
You enjoy shipping code early and often, working closely with products to build better software based on feedback from thousands of end users.
You embrace Klaviyo's "always learning" culture. We learn faster together, which is part of why this program happens in person.
You've already experimented with AI in work or personal projects, and you're excited to find ways to make your work smarter and more efficient.
Internship logistics
Our Summer Internship Program is an 11-week paid experience [June 1–August 13] at our Boston, MA headquarters. Interns are in office 5 days a week.
Offers will be team agnostic - interns are placed on a team approximately 30 days from the start of the program. Team placement can be on a full-stack, back-end, or front-end team within any of the pillars.
Before joining individual teams, all interns go through Klaviyo Base Camp, our onboarding experience built to get you up to speed on Klaviyo, our product, and the day-to-day of engineering here, plus time to get to know the other interns. You'll join your team ready to dive into real project work from day one.
Our Boston office is genuinely fun. Lunch is on us 5 days a week, along with free snacks and drinks, ping pong, Nintendo Switch, a golf simulator, and a speakeasy to unwind in.
Throughout the summer, interns get together for social events beyond team and project work: a Red Sox game, a Boston Harbor Cruise, trips to Kings and Versus, ice cream socials, and Ask Me Anything sessions with Klaviyo's senior leadership.
Apply before October 7 if you can. We interview and hire on a rolling basis.
Former intern projects
Built a new 'Share Inbox Preview' feature allowing users to generate public share links from the Email Editor.
Implemented an 'Invite Expiration Extension' endpoint in IAM with basic logging and validation.
Created a small dashboard that displays real-time delivery stats using existing API data and simple visualizations.
Migrated one internal service from Jenkins → Buildkite and documented the migration process.
Added an image and carousel support for WhatsApp Templates ensuring backward compatibility.
Engineering at Klaviyo
Our engineering teams are organized into pillars to keep the work focused.
Data Infrastructure:
Empower our internal teams and customers to get the best out of our data and agent platforms. underlying capabilities: Agent Platform, CDP revenue, Data Lake usage, Active API endpoints, Accounts with healthy API usage
MCMI:
Own the growth, revenue, and reliability of our mobile channels and all messaging infrastructure.
Core Infrastructure:
Empower our internal engineering, sales, and service teams to be as effective as possible by improving productivity of the eng, product, and design teams.
Growth Marketing Platform
: Give marketers the tools they need to engage with their customers, be successful, and know where they stand.
AI & Analytics:
Applies AI, data, and analytics to automate work, surface insights, and help customers make smarter decisions that maximize Klaviyo Attributed Value (KAV).
Autonomous Service:
Builds AI-powered customer service experiences that help resolve issues, support transactions, and connect customers with human assistance when needed.
If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't check every box, apply anyway. Some of the strongest Klaviyos didn't start with a perfect resume match.
This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.
Massachusetts Applicants:
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
Our salary range reflects the cost of labor across various U.S. geographic markets. The range displayed below reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries for the position across all our US locations. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant’s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.
In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company’s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.
Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary/OTE range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Get to Know Klaviyo
We’re Klaviyo (pronounced clay-vee-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we’re developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. To reach our goals, we need our own crew of remarkable creators—ambitious and collaborative teammates who stay focused on our north star: delighting our customers. If you’re ready to do the best work of your career, where you’ll be welcomed as your whole self from day one and supported with generous benefits, we hope you’ll join us.
AI fluency at Klaviyo includes responsible use of AI (including privacy, security, bias awareness, and human-in-the-loop). We provide accommodations as needed.

About Pacific Fusion
Pacific Fusion was founded in 2023 with the mission to power the world with abundant, affordable, clean energy.
We are rapidly designing and building a pulser-driven inertial fusion system to achieve net facility gain (more fusion energy output than stored energy input). In parallel, we are developing the key components required to build affordable fusion systems.
Our plans are ambitious. We have raised over $900M so far from incredible investors, resourcing us to deliver on these plans. We are bringing together the best scientists, engineers, and operators from the fusion community, hard tech industry, and other sectors. We are united by a shared sense of urgency to provide clean power for the world, particularly managing climate change while meeting growing global energy demand. You can read more about us in
this letter from our founders
.
Why This Role Matters
As a
Software Engineering Intern
, you will help build the user interfaces and backend software systems that allow engineers, scientists and operators to run the fusion demonstration facility. You will work closely with controls engineers, scientists, and operators to develop software that presents real-time system state, manages configuration and data, and supports safe facility operations.

Develop and improve web-based user interfaces for:
System status and health monitoring
Experiment or facility configuration
Alerts, events, and diagnostics
Assist in building backend services that:
Serve real-time and historical facility data
Manage configuration, metadata, and system state
Interface with controls systems and data pipelines
Support integration between:
UI applications, backend APIs, and facility systems
Write clear, maintainable code and contribute to code reviews
Help test, debug, and validate software used in live environments

Coursework or experience in:
Software development fundamentals
Web or backend programming
Familiarity with at least one of:
TypeScript / JavaScript
Go or Python
Basic understanding of:
Client–server applications
APIs and data flow
SQL and NoSQL Databases

Able to work full time, onsite for a minimum of
12 consecutive weeks
beginning in

Experience with:
React or other modern UI frameworks

Git and collaborative development
Interest in:
Industrial systems, automation, or controls
Data visualization or real-time systems
Exposure to:

GPA of 3.5 or above

Real resume building engineering experience

10 Weeks (Early June – Mid August)

PDT Partners – a quantitative investment manager - is seeking talented engineering students for Software Engineering focused internships. We are looking for interns who can add to a company that values creativity, energy, and collaborative problem solving.
Throughout our 10-week program, students work closely with supportive senior developers on individual projects, receive hands-on personalized mentorship, and contribute to PDT's culture through both intern and company wide social events.
Why join us?
PDT Partners has a 30+ year track record and a reputation for excellence. Our goal is to be the best quantitative investment manager in the world—measured by the quality of our products, not their size. Our people come from diverse disciplines, are intellectually extraordinary and our community is close-knit, down-to-earth and collaborative.
Internship Projects
Software Engineers at PDT are responsible for building and maintaining the technology the enables all parts of the trading life cycle. As a software engineering intern, you will work closely with expert developers on technically challenging projects to design, develop, debug, and test our software components for large handling of financial data, real-time events, and batch processing.
Depending on the specific project, you may:
Face problems that don't have well-defined solutions - creativity will be essential to come up with the best possible answers, including ones that explore new technologies
Learn about financial markets and quantitative trading
Build an understanding of various trading technologies and make contributions to them
Develop tooling used for infrastructure management
Contribute to the infrastructure and maintenance of large-scale data sets
The internship offers opportunities to correctly apply new idioms, techniques, and algorithms in select areas, which may include:
Program correctness - resource management, exception safety, reentrancy/thread safety
Maintainability - portability, good coding practices, adherence to coding standards, unit testing, documentation
Efficiency - optimal data structures/algorithms, understanding of high-/low- level implications and trade-offs in design choices, parallelization
Below is a list of skills and experiences we think are relevant. Even if you don’t think you’re a perfect match, we still encourage you to apply because we are committed to developing our people.
Excellent academic background from a rigorous computer science or engineering program graduating in Fall 2027 or later
Strong programming skills with a deep understanding of data structures and algorithms
Fast-learner, intellectually curious, problem-solving approach
Proactive with sense of urgency
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Interest in working in a world-class, professional environment
Committed to improvement and keen to apply constructive feedback
The salary for this role is $180,000.
This amount is not inclusive of any potential bonus amounts.

About Us:
Perpay is a certified B Corp and Philadelphia’s most impactful growth-stage startup. We are driven by a mission to significantly improve the financial stability of everyday Americans. For the past decade, we have established strong product-market fit and a profitable, efficient operating model across a suite of products, positioning Perpay as the premier financial partner for consumers with subprime credit.
With over 500,000 customers who have utilized more than $1 billion in spending power, we are at a pivotal moment. We are scaling our operations, building new offerings, and deepening our impact. We are looking for teammates eager to join us on this journey.
Our venture partners include First Round Capital and L Catterton.
Products we’ve built to make an impact:
Perpay Marketplace: Combines interest-free payments and modern e-commerce to reduce cost of ownership and promote healthy repayment behavior.
Perpay+: Leverages Marketplace repayment history to help members monitor and build credit with all 3 credit bureaus.
Perpay Credit Card: Expands access to the flexibility and benefits of a World Mastercard by removing common barriers like high security deposits and low approval odds.
Our team thrives on in-person collaboration, operating from our unique center-city Philadelphia office. This comfortable "home away from home" space offers river views and fosters rapid product development, strong relationships, and career growth. The energy from achieving big wins is palpable here. While we primarily work in the office, we offer sensible flexibility for personal needs, such as sick children or urgent errands, and coordinate official remote weeks around major holidays. If you are passionate about a meaningful mission, collaboration, equity, and generous perks, Perpay is the best place to be in Philadelphia right now.

As an intern at Perpay, your main responsibility is to learn. We understand the value of mentorship and offer students an opportunity to gain real work experience before graduation. In the 10-12 weeks we'll be together next summer (2027), you will have the opportunity to uncover and communicate insights from our company data that will inform decision-making on open and pressing business questions.
Candidates hired for this role will be placed on one of the following teams based on fit and business need, determined after the hiring process:
Strategic Analytics
Risk
Business Planning & Analysis (BP&A)

Previous work experience in a technical field

Lightweight data challenge

Phone call

posting.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.
Our mission is to democratize finance for all.
An estimated $124 trillion of assets
will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.
About the team + role
We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.
Our backend engineers sit at the core of how Robinhood works — powering the financial products that millions of people rely on every day. We build and scale the services, infrastructure, and data systems behind brokerage, crypto, payments, and more. We move fast, hold high standards, and solve problems that actually matter — at a scale that very few engineers ever get the chance to touch.
As a Software Engineering Intern, Backend, you won't be on the sidelines — you'll own a meaningful project end-to-end, from initial scoping through to production. You'll be embedded on a real team, working directly with experienced engineers, diving deep into how the US financial system actually operates, and shipping software that meets the correctness and scale requirements of a live financial platform. This is a summer where you'll leave with real impact to show for it!
This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, Bellevue, WA, or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.
At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.
What you'll do
Own a high-impact backend project from initial scoping through launch — you'll drive the work, not just support it
Partner with a dedicated mentor who will guide you from onboarding through shipping, deepening your understanding of our tech stack and financial domain along the way
Design, build, test, and release software solutions that meet the correctness and scalability requirements of a real financial platform
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Robinhood to solve critical problems that span the organization
Maintain and scale an existing codebase using technologies such as Python/Django, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Memcached, AWS, and Kubernetes
What you bring
Currently enrolled in a full-time, degree-seeking program with an expected graduation date of Winter 2027 or Spring 2028
Strong CS fundamentals and deep understanding of best coding practices
Solid communication skills and an ability to drive large projects forward in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment
Passion and interest in financial technology and building fintech products and services
Prior software engineering experience from internships, hackathons, or personal projects
Familiarity with Python/Django or Go, and an understanding of relational databases and transactions
What we offer
Market competitive compensation structure
Quarterly lifestyle wallet for personal wellness, learning and development, and more
Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not
Time away including company holidays, paid time off, and sick time
Lively office environment with catered meals, fully stocked kitchens, and geo-specific commuter benefits

ABOUT ROCKET LAB
Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.
As a Propulsion Design Intern based at Rocket Lab’s site in Long Beach, California, you will have the opportunity to support the team in design and analysis of components and subassemblies for the Archimedes engine. You will join our multidisciplinary propulsion team who is responsible for designing, analyzing, and building engine system hardware to accelerate Archimedes development.
WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO
As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within the department to apply your knowledge and grow your skills both technically and professionally
Work with a fast-paced group of professionals to apply engineering and industry concepts to solve real challenges
Attend frequent 1:1’s with mentors and supervisors to facilitate success and learning while providing progress updates
Enjoy tech talks and network with other interns and employees through social and professional events
YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS
Ideal candidates will thrive in ambiguity and are excited to work in small, high-performing teams that are focused on continued learning and growth. Success in this position will be measured by the knowledge and experience you bring to the role, your ability to lead development projects without supervision, and your ability to successfully collaborate across teams to deliver results.
Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s, master's or doctorate degree program in an Aerospace, Astronautical, Aeronautical or Mechanical engineering discipline and have at least one semester of school remaining post internship
GPA of 3.0 or above
3+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable)
THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE
GPA of 3.5 or above
6+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable)
Siemens NX and ANSYS Workbench experience
CAD/CAM experience
Fluid dynamics and fluid systems experience
Experience with liquid rocket engines
Python experience
Knowledge of heat transfer and fluid mechanics
Familiar with Structural fundamentals (statics)
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Able to work full-time, on-site for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning May or June 2027
COMPENSATION AND OTHER BENEFITS
Pay Range CA: $28.00 USD Hourly
You may be eligible for a stipend to subsidize relocation costs
Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.
Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

posting.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB
Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.
As a Security Analyst Intern based at Rocket Lab’s site in Albuquerque, New Mexico, you will have the opportunity to support Security Team in developing security education, conducting intelligence and risk assessments, network infrastructure research, physical security, and more. The Security Team leads physical security, program security and enterprise risk management, all of which are programs designed to protect Rocket Lab personnel, assets and intellectual property.
WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO
As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within the security department to apply your knowledge and grow your skills both technically and professionally.
Work with a fast-paced group of professionals to apply industry concepts to solve real challenges.
Attend frequent 1:1’s with mentors and supervisors to facilitate success and learning while providing progress updates.
Enjoy tech talks and network with other interns and employees through social and professional events.
YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS
Ideal candidates will thrive in ambiguity and are excited to work in small, high-performing teams that are focused on continued learning and growth. Success in this position will be measured by the knowledge and experience you bring to the role, your ability to lead development projects without supervision, and your ability to successfully collaborate across teams to deliver results.
Must be enrolled in an associates, bachelor’s, master's or doctorate degree program in field of criminal justice, national security, emergency management, or similar. and have at least one semester of school remaining post internship
GPA of 3.0
3+ months of general work experience (internships or other personal/team project experience is applicable)
THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE
GPA of 3.5 or above
Military experience, active duty or reserves, or ROTC
Experience in the aerospace or tech industry
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Able to work full-time, on-site for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning May or June 2027
COMPENSATION AND OTHER BENEFITS
Pay Range AZ: $18.00 USD Hourly
You may be eligible for a stipend to subsidize relocation costs
WHAT TO EXPECT
We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

posting.description:
About us
The first baby boomers turn 80 this year. Over the next decade, the population most likely to need daily care will grow faster than the buildings, the staff, or the systems available to serve it.
Sage is the care intelligence platform for senior living and skilled nursing. We connect the hardware senior care runs on, including nurse call, fall management, and wander management, with software caregivers actually use. That consistent use is what produces reliable data, and reliable data is what gives operators a true picture of how their communities are running.
Sage is a collaborative team of ambitious, multi-disciplinary entrepreneurs on a mission to reinvent senior care with a modern operating system for caregivers. Millions of people depend on this care getting better, and we move with the urgency that deserves.
About this role
As a Software Engineering Intern at Sage, you'll join a product engineering team as a full member from day one. You'll attend the same standups, contribute to the same roadmap, review the same pull requests, and ship to the same production codebase as the rest of your team.
This internship runs Monday, June 7, 2027 to Friday, August 13, 2027. You can also visit our
website
for more information about our internship program.
The software you build supports caregivers responding to real residents in real moments of need. Every feature, bug fix, and improvement has the potential to make someone's day easier, and someone's care better.
Throughout the internship, you'll work closely with an experienced engineer who will mentor you, help you grow, and give you meaningful feedback. By the end of the summer, you'll have shipped production software and shared what you built with the broader engineering organization.
What you'll do
Ship production code as part of a product engineering team, from your first pull request through deployment
Build user-facing experiences in React and TypeScript used every day by caregivers and senior living communities
Develop backend services in Java that power care workflows, notifications, and integrations with the systems our customers rely on
Write tests, participate in code reviews, and iterate on feedback as part of our engineering process
Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to scope, build, and deliver meaningful features
Learn what it takes to build and operate reliable software that people depend on every day
Minimum Qualifications
Strong programming fundamentals in at least one language, such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, or Python, with excitement to learn across the stack
Evidence that you enjoy building things, through coursework, personal projects, open source, internships, bootcamps, or self-directed work
Familiarity with web fundamentals, including APIs, HTTP, and databases
Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn quickly by asking thoughtful questions and acting on feedback
Strong communication skills and enthusiasm for collaborating in an environment where ideas are shared and code is reviewed
A genuine interest in building technology that serves people who are often overlooked by traditional software
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with React, Node.js, or a JVM language
Exposure to SQL or other databases
Experience using AI development tools such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar, along with the judgment to review and understand the code they generate
A project you're excited to demo, regardless of its level of polish
Interest in healthcare, aging, or mission-driven technology
What You'll Get
Meaningful ownership of production software from day one
A dedicated engineering mentor and regular, structured feedback
A behind-the-scenes look at how a hardware-and-software company builds, ships, and supports products at scale
The opportunity to present your work to the engineering organization and leave with real projects you can point to long after your internship ends
Compensation
Our headquarters are located near New York City's Union Square. We believe in cross team collaboration. We think good ideas can come from anyone, and we've designed our processes to encourage participation from all. While we take our mission seriously, we don't take ourselves too seriously. We like to host offsites, outings, and team meals where we can connect as people, not just as colleagues. We offer office lunch and a fully stocked snack bar. While we are an in-office culture, we allow up to 2 remote days per week.
This role is paid at $50/hour. As an internship position, it is not eligible for our standard employee benefits package (health insurance, stock options, PTO, etc.).
EEO Statement
Sage is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Sage makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. For 10 years, Scale has provided the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and has helped enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force.

posting.description:
At Stoke, we believe a thriving space economy will enable a vibrant, sustainable, and equitable future here on Earth. That is why we’re building Nova, our fully and rapidly reusable launch vehicle. Designed for daily flight, Nova tackles the core challenges of space transportation by reducing cost, increasing availability, and improving reliability. By radically lowering launch costs and increasing flight cadence, we’re helping create a truly scalable space industry.
Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and empowered to take ownership of their work. If you want to work alongside some of the most dedicated and talented people on Earth, we’d love to have you join us.
Description
We know that at the heart of every great challenge is an extraordinary team. Stoke is building a world-class team and we are excited to begin offering internship opportunities for the Summer of 2027. As an intern, you will work on real, open-ended problems that directly contribute to the success of the company. You will work closely with your mentor and other employees who will help you apply your knowledge and grow your skills through high-impact projects. You must be ready to stay focused, move fast, self-direct, and learn on the fly.
Software internships are available across the company within different teams such as Boltline, Vehicle Software, and Data.
Please note: these roles require you to work onsite at our Kent location.
Qualifications:
Pursuing Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science or a similar STEM field
Project-level experience with Python, C, or Rust
Exceptional command of engineering fundamentals
Hands-on engineering experience through internships, personal projects, work, or teams
Ability to manage a complex technical project and take it through execution
Ability to learn and apply state of the art techniques to technical projects
Excellent written and verbal communication
Able to work full-time, onsite for a minimum of 10-14 consecutive weeks starting in May 2027.
Various Teams:
Boltline (linked)
As a Software Engineering Intern on the Boltline by Stoke Space Team, you will be working on our web-based SaaS that helps advanced hardware manufacturing teams design, track, iterate, build and test in a fast and reliable manner. You will contribute to the full software lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, and deployment, in a fast-paced and iterative development environment.
Required qualifications:
Proficient in JavaScript or TypeScript
Experience in front-end or back-end software development
Preferred qualifications:
Experience in 1 or more of the technologies utilized in our tech stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Apollo, Express.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, AWS
Affinity for full-stack software development
Vehicle Software
As a Software Engineering Intern on the Vehicle Software Team, you will work on the control software stack that runs across the entire company - bench testers, environmental testers, engine test stands, and flight systems. You will own a chunk of software you take from design to running on the test stand in a fast-paced and iterative development environment.
Required Qualifications:
Proficient in Rust or other systems languages (C/C++)
Experience with real-time systems
Excited by fast-paced, critical software operations
Preferred qualifications:
Experience in embedded devices or autonomous systems
Experience with OS and kernel level work
Data
As a Software Engineering Intern on the Stoke Space Data Team, you will be working on converting our mountains of real-time and post-launch data into analysis and insights that will help Stoke more effectively design and operate our launch products. You will contribute to the full software lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, and deployment, in a fast-paced and iterative development environment.
Required Qualifications:
Proficient in Rust
Experience in front-end or back-end software development
Preferred qualifications
Experience in 1 or more of the technologies utilized in our tech stack: AWS, Time Series Data, Svelte, WebGPU
Affinity for full-stack software development
Benefits & Opportunities:
32 hours of paid time off
On-site gym (Kent, WA location)
Complimentary snacks & refreshments available on-site
Company events with Leadership team
Mentorship from industry-leading engineers
Direct ownership of real rocket products
Compensation
Freshman/Sophomore: $28.00/hour
Junior/Senior: $33.00/hour
Completed Bachelor's: $35.00/hour
Completed Master's: $40.00/hour
Your pay will be determined by academic level. You may also be eligible for relocation support.
At Stoke, we offer internships across three terms throughout the year. Please review our application windows below to determine the best timing for your application.
Spring
(Jan - April)
Application window: May - July
Summer
(May - Aug)
Application window: September - November
Fall
(Sept - Dec)
Application window: January - March

It is committed to compliance with all equal opportunity laws, including the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) and Title VII. It does not discriminate on the basis of nationality, race, citizenship, immigration status, or any other protected class when it comes to employment practices, including hiring.

checks, and on your ability to prove your identity and authorization to work in the U.S. for the Company. Employees must comply with the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services employment verification requirements, and, therefore, they must complete an Employment Eligibility Verification Form I-9 at the start of employment and re-verify authorization to work periodically.
Separate from this I-9 process, this position entails access to certain technology and technical data that is restricted under U.S. export control laws and regulations. The Basics
At Tanium, Software Engineering Interns have the opportunity to gain valuable, real-world experience in building B2B security focused applications. Assigned a senior engineer mentor and a peer intern buddy, you’ll work with our team directly on new features for the next release of Tanium’s platform. During your internship, you’ll build features that are delivered to Tanium’s customers, and get feedback on how your features are received. Don't miss out on the opportunity to network with your peer interns and build a community with Tanium’s diverse group of developers!
Examples of prior intern projects include:
A visualization tool for Tanium’s privileges and roles
Question prediction for Tanium’s natural language parser
A node.js module for presenting application health
This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of
three
days per week: Durham, NC or Emeryville, CA only
The hourly rate for this internship is $55.00 for Durham and $60.00 for Emeryville. This hourly rate is an estimate for what Tanium will pay an intern. The actual rate offered may be adjusted based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, education, skills, training, and experience. In addition to an hourly rate, interns will be eligible for 401k matching and a monthly allowance for communications reimbursement.
What you'll do:
Be assigned to either a frontend or backend team, depending on your ranked preference / our available projects.
Experience first–hand engineering in a software security company – work in the real world on frameworks and new features for our product.
Meet regularly with your 1-1 mentor.
Produce a unique deliverable to put on your resume.
Show off what you’ve built to our entire team at the end of your internship – get great exposure to engineering leadership!
Participate in intern events and network with our wider internship cohort of 70+ interns.
We are looking for someone who is:
Authorized to work in the U.S. now and in the future
Available to work full-time from June 7, 2026 to August 13, 2026
Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's degree
in computer science or a related degree program.
GPA of 3.5 or above REQUIRED
Graduating Spring 2028 or Fall 2027
Experienced in creating and finishing software development projects in backend and/or frontend languages
Excited and driven to learn new technical skills
Passionate about technology, software, and figuring out how things work
A great communicator and can collaborate with a team as well as work independently
A past internship is helpful, but not required.

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. Driven by AI and real-time endpoint intelligence, Tanium Autonomous IT empowers IT and security teams to make their organizations unstoppable.

www.tanium.com
and follow us on
LinkedIn
and
X

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. posting.description:
About Viam
Founded by Eliot Horowitz, co-founder and former CTO of MongoDB, Viam is a novel robotics engineering platform that lets you configure, control, and manage robots intuitively and quickly. We’re inspiring a generation of engineers to solve complicated automation problems with our uniquely powerful suite of software tools.
We’re a ~100-person company headquartered in New York City.
Viam's products are built by engineers, for engineers. We want to build a platform we would want to use ourselves. We are looking for students studying computer science or related fields to collaborate with our full-time engineers on building out the software for our platform. Working across the stack on the new and unique problems in robotics and cloud computing
Fully integrated with the full-time engineering organization, matched to a specific team with an assigned mentor

In the process of receiving a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or related field, with at least one additional term after the end of the internship

posting.description:
WWM Logistics, LLC is seeking a Data Science Intern to support its natural gas trading desk. This role sits at the intersection of daily market reporting and deeper quantitative analysis, providing traders with the timely fundamental data they need to evaluate supply and demand, while also partnering with the Data Scientist and Strategist on model development aimed at generating trading signals. This is an ideal opportunity for a detail-oriented, quantitatively skilled early-career professional looking to build a career in commodity trading and market analytics.
This role is the natural next step for graduates of WWM's Natural Gas Analyst / Data Science Internship. Completion of the internship is valued but not required – we also hire directly into this role.
Responsibilities:
Daily Fundamentals Reporting
Build, maintain, and deliver standardized daily reports summarizing natural gas supply and demand fundamentals (production, storage, weather-driven demand, pipeline flows, rig counts) used directly by traders to inform positioning
Own the rollout of these standardized reports and monitor them on an ongoing basis, troubleshooting data issues and refining processes to reduce manual turnaround time and improve reliability
Monitor and flag material shifts in fundamental data that could influence price movement, escalating findings to traders and senior analysts in real time
Maintain data integrity across multiple third-party and internal data sources (e.g., EIA, pipeline bulletin boards, weather services, production estimates)
Modeling & Analytics
Partner with the Data Scientist and Strategist to develop and refine quantitative models aimed at identifying trading signals from fundamental and market data
Support back-testing and validation of new analytical approaches, helping translate research into production-ready tools
Assist in building supply/demand balance models and scenario analyses across key basins and pipeline systems
Contribute to the automation and scaling of data pipelines that feed both daily reporting and longer-term research projects
Cross-Functional Support
Collaborate with traders to understand evolving information needs and adjust reporting/modeling priorities accordingly
Support ad hoc analysis requests tied to specific trading opportunities, contract structuring, or market events
Document methodologies and maintain clear version control across reporting and modeling tools
Qualifications:
Required
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, preferably a May 2028 grad.
Working knowledge of SQL and Python or similar language for data analysis
Demonstrated interest in commodity markets, trading, or energy fundamentals (coursework, internships, trading simulations/competitions, or independent projects)
Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage recurring deliverables under time pressure
Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical analysis for a trading audience
WhiteWater does not offer housing. Position is required to be in-office at our Austin location
Preferred
Prior completion of WWM's Data Science Internship, or equivalent internship experience in energy trading, fundamentals, or data analytics
Master's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau)
Prior exposure to natural gas or broader energy markets
Experience with trading simulations, mock portfolios, or derivatives strategy
Ability to think critically and explain technical work to other colleagues
What Success Looks Like in the First Year
:
Fully owns and continuously improves the daily fundamentals reporting suite, with traders relying on it as a core input to daily decision-making
Has contributed meaningfully to at least one modeling initiative alongside the Data Scientist/Strategist that has been incorporated into trading discussions
Demonstrates growing fluency in natural gas market structure, pipeline mechanics, and the specific basins/systems relevant to the desk's positions

Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

Lab Intern
to join our team located in
Burlington, NC

Monday-Friday 8:00am-4:30pm / 40hrs per week

• Shadow laboratory professionals and learn diagnostic workflows, instrumentation, and department operations
• Assist with non-testing laboratory tasks, such as specimen organization, inventory, and workspace preparation

• Support approved laboratory projects
• Follow all safety and compliance standard operating procedures

• Current enrollment in a Chemical, Biological, Clinical Laboratory Science or Medical Technology Bachelor’s degree program

:

Live Oak Bank is a digital bank that serves small business owners across the country. Our groundbreaking spin on service and technology has fueled our mission to be America’s Small Business Bank. Our products help customers buy, build, and expand their business, and our high-yield savings and CD products help them grow their hard-earned money. At Live Oak, we never lose sight of the well-being of our people. We believe our employees are the heart of our company. Our commitment to our customers and culture is intertwined, and we seek those who embody and embrace what it takes to empower the American dream.
Ready to make an impact?
We're looking for an intern to join our team for the onsite 10-week Summer 2027 Internship Program (May 17 - July 23, 2027) at our headquarters in Wilmington, NC. Applications are due by 11:59 p.m. ET on Wednesday, September 23.
How This Role Impacts Live Oak and Its People
Live Oak is putting AI in the hands of every employee, not just engineers. That creates a gap most banks never staff: someone who can sit with a lending team for two days, understand what actually slows them down, and leave behind a working solution — then turn around and teach forty people how to build the next one themselves.
This internship is that gap. You will spend the summer embedded with real teams across the bank, building AI solutions alongside them and making the people around you more capable than they were before you arrived. You will ship things employees use, and you will strengthen the AI champions and skills librarians who carry this work forward after you leave.
We hire interns who build. Ex: a successful 2026 intern was a business major who had founded a company, shipped production websites for paying clients, and used AI as core infrastructure rather than a novelty.
What You'll Do at Live Oak
Forward-Deployed Engineering — roughly half your time
Embed with business teams
across lending, deposits, credit, and operations to find the workflows where AI removes real friction — then build the solution with them, not for them.
Ship working tools fast
using Claude, Claude Code, Power Automate, and low-code platforms. Prototype in days, not quarters. Expect what you build to be in real use before your first month ends.
Translate between worlds
by turning a lender's challenge into a scoped problem statement, and turning a technical constraint into language a business leader can act on.
Document what you build
so the team maintains it after you leave. A solution that dies when the intern leaves was never a solution.
Enablement & Training — roughly a third of your time
Support our AI champions and skills librarians
by enhancing the training materials, reusable skills, and internal documentation they need to scale adoption inside their own business units.
Run hands-on training
for employees at every level — from people who have never opened an AI tool to power users who want to build their own agents.
Create artifacts that outlast the session
including prompt libraries, reusable skills, quick-reference guides, and short video walkthroughs.
Support & Measurement — the remainder
Field questions and unblock employees
on our enterprise AI tools. Every recurring question is a signal about missing training or missing tooling; you will spot the pattern and close the gap.
Measure whether any of this is working
by defining and tracking adoption, usage, and time-saved metrics so leadership can tell genuine impact apart from enthusiasm.
Bring back what you find
in a summer-end readout to senior leadership: where AI is creating value at Live Oak, where it is stalling, and what you would do next.
Required
Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program
A portfolio, GitHub, or set of shipped projects you can walk us through. Side businesses, automations, websites, bots, and tools you built
Demonstrated fluency with AI tools as part of how you work — not just as something you have tried. Be ready to show us the last thing you built with one.
Ability to write and speak clearly to non-technical people.
Comfort with ambiguity and self-direction.
Preferred
Experience building with modern web or automation stacks.
Experience teaching, tutoring, mentoring, or leading a team — formally or otherwise.
Exposure to a regulated industry, or real curiosity about why banks work the way they do. Understanding the constraint is what makes a solution usable.
Enough data analysis ability to build a measurement framework and defend the numbers in it.
#LI-DNI
Our Values
Dedication:
Possess a deep commitment to Live Oak Bank’s mission and core values, exemplified through a strong work ethic, adaptability and pride in your work.
Ownership:
Take initiative to deliver positive results by proactively and creatively solving problems, while maintaining a high degree of quality.
Respect:
Treat everyone with courtesy, politeness, and kindness.
Innovation:
Embrace fresh ideas and fearlessly contribute new solutions to emerging or existing problems.
Teamwork:
Foster collaboration, accountability, and trust with others and understand that together, we do more

Thank you for dedicating your time and talent to Lowe’s. We want to give you more opportunities to learn and grow, so if you find a position you’re interested in below, we encourage you to apply!
Your Impact
As an Exploratory Software Engineer Intern at Lowe’s, you’ll work on emerging technologies and innovative ideas that could shape the future of retail technology. This role is designed for curious and experimental minds interested in prototyping solutions, testing new frameworks, and exploring disruptive technologies such as AI/ML, AR/VR, computer vision, and IoT. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring ideas from concept to code, and you'll play a vital role in our commitment to continuous innovation.
This is an opportunity to explore the unknown, fail fast, and learn faster, all while gaining exposure to how innovation is driven at an enterprise scale.
Summer Internship Program
Whether you're starting your professional journey or pivoting to a new field, Lowe's offers the resources and opportunities you need to thrive.
Our 10-week summer internship program (May 24 – July 30, 2027) immerses you in real-world retail operations. Drive innovation with fresh perspectives and an eagerness to learn.
Bring dynamic energy while staying open to inspiration.
Take on challenges with sharp thinking and embrace new opportunities.
Build strong partnerships through collaborative teamwork.
Push boundaries to discover what's possible.

Prototype experimental software solutions using modern languages and platforms (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Swift, Unity).

Collaborate in innovation sprints with engineers, designers, and product managers.

Understand how innovation is fostered in a corporate tech environment and contribute to shaping future products and services.

Programme dates: June 2027
Please review all the internship programme opportunities and make
one application.
Our
Summer Business Analyst Internship Programme
has been crafted to simulate our Business Graduate Programme so that you can understand what a career with LSEG would really be like.
Join LSEG’s Markets division
and be part of a dynamic team that powers global financial markets and helps organisations navigate risk with confidence. This internship programme brings together our Capital Markets and Post Trade businesses to offer a comprehensive suite of solutions—from raising and trading capital across asset classes and geographies, to clearing and optimising portfolios, to managing regulatory, reputational and financial risk.
Whether it’s enabling companies to list and grow on the London Stock Exchange, supporting seamless post-trade operations, or delivering trusted data and tools like World-Check and identity verification services, you’ll be at the heart of the financial ecosystem. You’ll gain exposure to cutting-edge platforms like FXall and Tradeweb, work with clients across the globe, and help shape the future of financial markets.
This is a great opportunity for students studying
a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics subject to apply their skills to Business related role.
During the recruitment process we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align with the needs of the business to place you in your first rotation.
To be eligible, you must be a penultimate year undergraduate student due to complete all the requirements of your course summer 2027.
These are real roles. Our 9 weeks summer interns play a part in the success of our organisation, just like they would do as a graduate.
Programme Dates:
June to August 2027 (exact dates to be confirmed based on university term schedules).
What we are looking for:
We are passionate about recruiting people who want to understand the full breadth of our organisation, how it fits together, how it functions – and are interested in playing a part of our development, as it grows and diversifies.
You should have a demonstrable interest in financial markets, which you’ve built through your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.
Competent and comfortable with large data sets and able to code in the relevant languages (Python, SQL) or an understanding of tools like Tableu, Power BI
A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions.
Individuals who are able to connect the dots and think strategically.
The environment we work in is fast paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands.
People who can collaborate with others, using their strong communication skills in the process.
Studying an Engineering field or Finance, Economics with a strong inclination towards FinTech/Technology.
Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the UK without restrictions for the duration of the programme.
You will stand out to us if you can demonstrate and recognise that what you achieve is equally important as how you achieve it.
Application close: 30th October,
however we recommend an early application as we consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend an early application.
Recruitment Process:
The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume.
The next stage of the application process is an untimed Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG.
The second stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style
The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.
Please review all the internship programme opportunities and make
one application
If you make more than one application, we will review your first application only.
Please note, all our assessment centres are held virtually.
At LSEG, we provide our employees with a comprehensive benefits portfolio as part of a competitive total rewards package. Our benefit plans are designed to supplement the financial, emotional and physical wellbeing of our employees and their families at all stages of their life. We encourage an appreciative, collaborative and inclusive culture that promotes employee and organisational wellbeing.
We believe in remunerating our people with a variety of attractive benefits such as:
Emotional Wellbeing:
Annual wellness allowance; Employee assistance programme
Physical Wellbeing:
Private Medical Insurance; Optional dental Insurance; Gym membership & discounts
Financial Wellbeing:
Life Insurance; Income protection; Pension
Other benefits:
MyOffers: access to a range of retail discounts
We believe hybrid working makes more possible and recognise difference as a good thing. We want to set everyone up to bring their best self to work. Everyone will spend time with colleagues in the office (3 days), but you’ll be trusted to work flexibly, in a way that delivers excellence.
Career Stage:
Associate
Compensation/Benefits
Information:
LSEG is committed to offering competitive Compensation and Benefits. The anticipated base salary for this position is $55,500 - $92,500.
Please be aware base salary ranges may vary by geographic location, city and state. In addition to our offered base salary, this role is eligible for our Variable Incentive Compensation plan. Powerex-Iwata Air Technology Inc.
As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—
you’ll
be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way.
We’re
committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where
everyone’s
empowered to be their best.
Sales Engineering Co-op
Locations:
Harrison, Ohio (rotation 1) – Mount Juliet, TN (rotation 2)
Term:
Co-op
Come join Powerex, an industry leading provider of oil free compressed air and vacuum technology, where engineering excellence, innovation, and customer impact drive everything we do.
WHO WE ARE:
Powerex is an industry leader who designs and builds oil free compressed air and vacuum systems used in environments where performance matters most, from hospitals and laboratories to transit systems, and advanced manufacturing operations. For more than three decades, our teams of engineers, technicians, manufacturing and sales professionals have partnered with customers to solve complex technical challenges and deliver highly reliable, application driven solutions.
As part of Marmon and Berkshire Hathaway, Powerex offers the stability of a well-capitalized organization combined with the agility of a growing business. Employees have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, develop technical expertise, and build long term careers while contributing to systems that support critical infrastructure across multiple industries.
WHY CHOOSE THE POWEREX SALES ENGINEERING CO-OP:
Are you an engineering student who enjoys working with people to solve technical problems? The Powerex Sales Engineering Co-op program provides a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience at the intersection of sales, engineering, business, and customer engagement. Unlike traditional engineering co-ops, this role provides exposure to the business side of engineering. Students work alongside experienced sales professionals to learn how complex engineered systems are specified, built, sold and supported. You’ll visit customer sites and interact with industry professionals, while developing communication and leadership skills that set you apart from traditional engineering graduates.
Position Summary
The
Sales Engineering Co-op
will support the sales team in expanding Powerex’s presence in the medical piped equipment and laboratory markets. The co-op will assist with territory management, customer support, product education, and market development activities while developing a strong understanding of consultative, relationship-driven technical sales, customer needs and industrial systems.
Key Responsibilities
Support the sales team with quotation, submittal, and follow-up activities
Learn about the Medical Gas and Laboratory Gas industries – products, applications, markets, sales cycles
Learn how to go to market with a distribution network
Participate in customer visits, sales calls, and training sessions alongside senior sales staff
Assist with product and application training materials and presentations
Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and account tracking
Maintain and update customer and opportunity data in CRM systems
Learn about industry regulations, particularly NFPA 99
Knowledge, Skills & Experience
Currently pursuing a BS/BA degree (Engineering, Business, Sales, Marketing, or related field preferred)
Interest in technical or consultative sales and engineering-driven products
Strong communication, organization, and time-management skills
Ability to interact professionally with engineers, contractors, and customers
Self-motivated with a willingness to learn and take initiative
Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint; CRM exposure is a plus
Technical curiosity — experience or coursework related to engineering systems is beneficial but not required
Minimum 3.0 GPA
Travel Exposure
Co-op students will have opportunities to travel with experienced sales professionals to:
Visit hospitals, laboratories, and industrial facilities
Meet consulting engineers and contractors
Participate in customer training events
Observe how technical solutions are evaluated and specified
Travel expenses are fully covered.
What You’ll Gain
Real-world experience in technical, consultative sales
Learn how engineered systems are specified, sold, and supported
Hands-on mentorship from experienced sales and engineering professionals
Develop professional presentation and customer-facing communication skills
Exposure to healthcare, laboratory, and industrial markets
Experience working with distributors, contractors, consulting engineers, and facility owners
Explore a career path that combines technical sales with an engineering skill set.
Many successful co-op students are considered for future co-op rotations or full-time opportunities with Powerex upon graduation.

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.
At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.
Your Team, Your Impact
Marvell's firmware engineering teams span multiple cutting-edge domains, giving you the opportunity to work on technologies that power next-generation cloud, AI, storage, and networking solutions. Firmware engineers may contribute to secure, high-performance firmware for compute and custom ASIC platforms, embedded software for SSDs, or trusted firmware stacks for hardware security modules. Other teams focus on networking innovation, developing tools and firmware for dynamic services, or creating embedded solutions for high-speed PAM4 DSP chips and optical communication links. Across all groups, you’ll collaborate with hardware and software engineers to deliver robust, scalable solutions that enable Marvell’s leadership in data infrastructure.
What You Can Expect
As a Firmware Engineer Intern at Marvell, you could:
Develop and maintain embedded firmware
for advanced hardware platforms, including data center, AI devices, SSD controllers, DSP networking chips, and high-speed PAM4 DSPs.
Design and implement device drivers
and firmware features for communication protocols (SPI, I2C, I3C, UART, MDIO, PCIe, NVMe) and RTOS-based systems.
Participate in full product lifecycle
: concept, design, implementation, testing, validation, and release to customers.
Create and enhance automation scripts
(Python, shell, bash) for testing, failure analysis workflows, and infrastructure management.
Develop provisioning software and trusted firmware stacks
to enable advanced security features for SoCs, including cryptography and secure protocols (TLS/SSL, IPSec).
Collaborate with cross-functional teams
(Hardware, System, QA, Customer Solutions) for integration, debugging, and performance optimization.
Design and execute unit, system, and integration tests
, including regression planning and continuous integration (Jenkins).
Support lab testing and data analysis

Work on mission-critical features
for top-tier cloud customers and gain exposure to DSP concepts (Equalizers, Filters) and networking fundamentals (Ethernet, TCP/IP, OSI model).
Debug complex hardware/software issues
, drive root cause analysis, and manage fixes through issue tracking systems (e.g., Jira).

About the team:
The Kubernetes Engineering team is responsible for designing, operating, and modernizing Mastercard’s enterprise Kubernetes platform, supporting approximately 500 Amazon EKS and Azure AKS clusters across multiple global regions. This team enables the infrastructure that powers a global payments network, driving initiatives such as GitOps-based deployments with Argo CD, cloud-agnostic networking solutions using Kubernetes Gateway API, policy-driven security and compliance automation, platform onboarding for new business units, and fleet-wide observability and cost optimization. Job Summary
With more than 50 years of consecutive growth, we’ve built a dynamic workplace where over 45,000 employees worldwide are empowered to grow and contribute to our entrepreneurial culture.
As we continue to grow, we’re looking for talented individuals, like you, to join our team. Our people are genuine, creative, and proactive problem-solvers who move fast, move mountains, and succeed together.
A Medline internship provides real-world, hands-on experience where you can make a true impact. Interns take ownership of projects while gaining valuable insight into the day-to-day responsibilities of their roles. Beyond the work itself, the summer experience includes enriching opportunities such as social and networking events, leadership presentations, community service activities, and more. Through meaningful work and professional development experiences, you’ll build a tangible skillset that helps set you apart from your peers.
Our internships span a variety of business areas and are open to rising seniors in undergraduate programs. Designed to support both personal and professional growth, the 10-week summer program runs from early June through mid-August in one of our four corporate offices in the Chicagoland area.
As an RPA & Agentic AI Software Technologies Intern on the Digital Automation team, you will gain hands-on experience working at the intersection of Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and Agentic AI. You will collaborate with our Information business, and development teams to identify opportunities to automate and improve business processes using technologies such as UiPath, Copilot Studio, and AI/agentic automation frameworks.
This internship provides exposure to real-world enterprise automation projects and the opportunity to learn how AI agents and RPA can work together to transform business processes.
Job Description
Projects/responsibilities could include:
Assist in designing, developing, testing, and deploying RPA solutions using UiPath, with a focus on process automation, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Explore and assist with the development of AI-powered and agentic automation solutions, including AI agents that can interpret information, make decisions, orchestrate tasks, and interact with enterprise systems.
Gain hands-on experience with Microsoft AI and automation technologies, such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Copilot Studio, Foundry, App Insights.
Assist with integrating AI agents, RPA bots, APIs, applications, databases, and enterprise systems to enable end-to-end automated workflows.
Participate in the development and testing of proofs of concept (POCs) for emerging AI and automation technologies and help evaluate their potential for enterprise adoption.
Apply process analysis and problem-solving techniques to identify opportunities to eliminate manual work, improve cycle times, reduce errors, and enhance the user experience.
Work on real-world automation projects throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, understand user needs, contribute to UX design, and troubleshoot technical issues.
Assist with documenting business processes, automation workflows, AI agent designs, technical specifications, test cases, and solution architecture.
Learn and apply best practices related to responsible AI, security, governance, exception handling, monitoring, and human-in-the-loop automation.
Stay current with emerging trends in Agentic AI, RPA, generative AI, low-code development, and intelligent automation, and recommend innovative ideas for improving business processes.
Qualifications:
Junior standing with a minimum 3.0 GPA preferred.
Background in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence or related field
Strong interest in automation, artificial intelligence, RPA, or intelligent automation
Basic understanding of software development concepts, including
APIs, databases, application integration, and software development lifecycle (SDLC)
Familiarity with programming languages such as
Python, JavaScript, C#, or similar languages is a plus
Prior experience with UiPath, Copilot Studio, or similar platforms is beneficial but not required
Interest or coursework in
Generative AI, machine learning, natural language processing, or AI agents is a plus.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex business processes into logical steps.
Ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them to real-world problems.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Positive attitude, curiosity, and willingness to experiment with emerging AI and automation technologies.

Job Title:
Summer 2027 Intern-Research Intern for Polymers
Summary:
The intern will gain hands-on experience in plastics formulation, processing, testing, and data-driven product development. Under the guidance of a mentor, the intern will design and conduct experiments to evaluate the effects of processing additives on various plastics, analyze and interpret experimental data, and use AI and machine learning tools to support formulation optimization and product innovation.
Responsibilities Include:
Polymer Sample Preparation and Processing
Receive hands-on training from a mentor using plastics processing equipment, including extruders and blown-film lines.
Prepare polymer formulations containing processing additives and evaluate their performance.
Test and Characterization Method Development
Develop and refine testing protocols for evaluating polymer formulations on film-processing equipment.
Improve characterization methods used to quantify polymer processing-aid performance and impact on material properties.
AI/ML-Assisted Product Development
Work with the mentor to apply AI, machine learning, and data-analysis tools to experimental datasets.
Use data-driven methods to identify trends, predict formulation performance, and optimize product compositions
Document modeling approaches, results, and recommendations to support future product-development activities

Interest in learning plastics processing, material characterization, and AI/ML-assisted formulation optimization.
Experience with statistical analysis, Python, R, MATLAB, JMP, Minitab, or machine learning tools is preferred but not required
